description: Schedule a maintenance window: checks and alerts stop for its monitors during the window, and the status pages you pass announce it. Public once it has status pages: confirm with the user first.

end_date.description: End, after start_date, ISO 8601 with a timezone, e.g. "2026-10-04T02:00:00Z" or "2026-10-04T04:00:00+02:00".

language.description: Two-letter code of the language the text is written in, e.g. "fr". Defaults to the status page's default language.

message.description: Public description of the work, shown on the status pages and sent to subscribers.

monitors.description: Monitors (mon_...), components (comp_...) or servers (agt_...) under maintenance: their checks and alerts stop during the window.

name.description: Internal name, shown in the dashboard only.

notify.description: Subscriber notification: now, "scheduled" before the start, or "none" (default).

notify_minutes_before.description: With notify "scheduled": minutes before the start. Default 60.

status_pages.description: UUIDs of the status pages that announce the window.

timezone.description: IANA timezone the window is scheduled in, e.g. "Europe/Paris". start_date and end_date without an offset are read in it. Subscriber messages are dated in it when the status page has no timezone. Defaults to the project's timezone, else UTC.

title.description: Public title on the status pages. Defaults to name.

name: create_maintenance_window
title: Schedule maintenance
